_comment: Shared by the Go pane parser (run_sign_in_test.go) and the console's device-URL extractor (login-pty-extract.test.ts). sign_in_process is whether an `aws sso login` process is running in the sandbox when the pane is read; go is GET /runs/{id}/sign-in's answer for the two; ts is extractDeviceVerificationUrl's result for the pane, which is the latest link whether or not it is still waiting.

cases.name: a waiting attempt
cases.pane:
wardyn: sign-in running — AWS sign-in sandbox. Finish the device-code step in your browser. Nothing else runs here.
Browser will not be automatically opened.
Please visit the following URL:

https://device.sso.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/

Then enter the code:

ABCD-EFGH

Alternatively, you may visit the following URL which will autofill the code upon verification:
https://device.sso.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/?user_code=ABCD-EFGH

wardyn: aws sso credential captured
wardyn: sign-in command finished — this pane is now a plain shell.
agent@sandbox:~$
